name: Katsuragi Shirou
source: Mamoru's close friend and classmate. He acts like a rare idiot and pervert most of the time, which often makes Mamoru and Maria angry and violent towards Shirou. But sometimes he can find the right words for his friend and help him in a dangerous situation.
